{{Locations|Rebel Controlled Sector|Rebel Stronghold|LRSmap=ship|unique=true}}


''A Rebel ship is patrolling this beacon, and immediately turns to engage. As your crew scramble to battle readiness, sensors detect a short-range teleporter signal. An intruder is on board!''
*''A flushed and panicky rebel soldier has teleported aboard. The rebel, who appears unarmed, repeatedly declares his peaceful intentions. It seems the rebel life has lost its charm.''
*# Accept his proposal, and prepare to fight the Rebel ship.
*#* {{DuplicateEvent|3}} ''Relieved and light-headed, your new crew member gets to work as the Rebel ship attacks.''
*#** You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">Human crewmember</span> and fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
*#* ''The dishonorable Rebel has deceived you. He damages your ship and steals your flight data before teleporting away. The fleet will be able to track you with ease. If they can't kill you now, that is!''
*#** Your ship takes <span style="color:red">3 hull</span> damage, 1 damage to <span style="color:red">engines</span>; Rebel Fleet <span style="color:red">pursuit</span> is <span style="color:red">doubled</span>, and you fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
*#* ''Your new crew-member smiles, then reveals a small remote trigger in the palm of his hand. Explosions rocket around the ship as more intruders teleport aboard!''
*#** Your ship takes <span style="color:red">3 hull</span> damage; <span style="color:red">2 human boarders</span> beam aboard your ship and you fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
*#* ''The Rebel makes to take his assigned station, then suddenly turns and eviscerates the nearest crew-member. Red Alert!''
*#** You <span style="color:red">lose</span> a <span style="color:red">crewmember</span>; <span style="color:red">1 human boarder</span> beams aboard your ship and you fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).

==Quest Marker==
{{Long-Ranged Scanners info|shipdetected=nolrs+noship}}
*''Arriving at the specified coordinates, you find a sizable stash of useful materials.''
** You receive {{Tooltip|high|fuel: 3-6 ; missiles: 4-8 ; drone parts: 1-2}} [[Rewards#Stuff|resources with some scrap]].
*''You arrive at location of the hoard, but discover that it was not quite as large as advertised.''
** You receive low [[Rewards#Scrap_only|scrap]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "ALISON_DEFECTOR" in the datafiles.
*If the Rebel offers to lead you to a cache on first reject, a crew icon will appear if one of the three positive outcomes was chosen. This is because the developers forgot to mark the crew adding tag as hidden, normally done when the developers intended for you to risk accepting the offer in return for a negative outcome, as is the case in this event.
